required_patterns.client-directive: All interactive components must start with 'use client' directive at the top of the file
required_patterns.class-variance-authority: UI primitives must use CVA (class-variance-authority) for variant management with defined variant types
required_patterns.radix-slot-composition: Composable components should integrate @radix-ui/react-slot for asChild prop pattern
required_patterns.cn-utility: All className props must use cn() utility from lib/utils for intelligent class merging

architectural_constraints.component-structure: Follow pattern: imports → helper components → main component → export. Helper components defined above main component within same file
architectural_constraints.variants-pattern: Define variants using CVA with default variants specified. Common variants: default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link
architectural_constraints.accessibility: Include proper ARIA attributes, focus states, keyboard navigation support, and screen reader compatibility
architectural_constraints.composition-over-props: Use Radix Slot pattern (asChild prop) to allow component composition without wrapper div proliferation

required_patterns.framer-motion: All animations must use Framer Motion library exclusively. No CSS animations or transitions for complex animations
required_patterns.performance-mode-integration: Complex animations must respect usePerformanceMode hook - disable heavy animations when shouldReduceMotion is true (mobile < 768px)
required_patterns.animate-presence: Exit animations require AnimatePresence wrapper with mode='wait' for page transitions
required_patterns.viewport-once: Scroll-triggered animations should use whileInView with viewport={{ once: true }} to prevent re-triggering on scroll

architectural_constraints.animation-structure: Use initial, animate, exit, transition props. Define keyframes as arrays: animate={{ y: [0, -10, 0] }}
architectural_constraints.stagger-pattern: Parent-child staggered animations use variants pattern with staggerChildren in parent transition
architectural_constraints.performance-thresholds: Background decorative animations (orbs, particles) must be conditionally rendered based on !shouldReduceMotion check
architectural_constraints.timing-functions: Prefer ease functions: 'easeOut', 'easeInOut', [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] (custom cubic-bezier for curtain effects)
architectural_constraints.duration-guidelines: Fast interactions: 0.2-0.3s, Page transitions: 0.5-1.2s, Background loops: 10-30s

required_patterns.intersection-observer: All lazy loading must use custom hooks (useLazyLoad or useLazyLoadMultiple) built on IntersectionObserver API
required_patterns.ref-attachment: Attach returned ref to container element: const { ref, isLoaded } = useLazyLoad(); <div ref={ref}>
required_patterns.conditional-rendering: Images must conditionally render based on loading state: isImageLoaded(src) ? <Image /> : <Placeholder />
required_patterns.image-placeholder: Unloaded images must show ImagePlaceholder component with spinner animation

architectural_constraints.hook-configuration: useLazyLoad accepts options: { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '50px', fallbackSrc: null }
architectural_constraints.multiple-images-pattern: For galleries, use useLazyLoadMultiple to batch-load images with 100ms stagger delay between loads
architectural_constraints.error-handling: Hooks must handle load failures gracefully with hasError state and optional fallbackSrc
architectural_constraints.preload-strategy: Critical above-fold images (hero section) should use priority={true} and loading='eager' instead of lazy loading

required_patterns.next-themes-provider: Theme management exclusively via next-themes library wrapped in ThemeProvider component
required_patterns.css-variables: All colors defined as CSS custom properties in :root and .dark selectors in globals.css
required_patterns.semantic-tokens: Use semantic color tokens (--color-primary, --color-background) never raw hex values in components
required_patterns.theme-toggle-component: Theme switching via toggle-mode.jsx component with Sun/Moon icons from lucide-react

architectural_constraints.provider-configuration: ThemeProvider in root layout with: attribute='class', defaultTheme='dark', enableSystem={false}, disableTransitionOnChange
architectural_constraints.color-system: 18+ semantic tokens: primary, secondary, accent, muted, destructive, background, foreground, border, input, ring, chart-1 through chart-5, sidebar variants
architectural_constraints.transition-handling: disableTransitionOnChange prevents flash during theme switches. Components handle transitions via CSS transition properties

required_patterns.next-image-component: All images must use Next.js Image component from next/image for automatic optimization
required_patterns.fill-or-dimensions: Specify either width/height props OR fill prop with parent position:relative. Never omit sizing
required_patterns.priority-flag: Above-fold images (hero section) must include priority={true} prop to prevent LCP issues
required_patterns.object-fit-specification: Images with fill prop require className='object-cover' or 'object-contain' for proper sizing

architectural_constraints.format-conversion: Next.js automatically converts to WebP/AVIF. No manual format specification needed
architectural_constraints.responsive-sizing: Use responsive aspect ratios: aspect-video for project thumbnails, fixed dimensions for logos/icons
architectural_constraints.loading-strategy: Hero images: priority={true} loading='eager', Gallery images: lazy loading via useLazyLoad hook
architectural_constraints.alt-text-requirement: All images must have descriptive alt text for accessibility and SEO

required_patterns.centralized-data-file: All static content data must be exported from lib/data.js as named exports (categories, projectsData)
required_patterns.array-based-structure: Content stored as arrays of objects with consistent shape across all entries
required_patterns.id-based-references: All data objects include numeric id field for React key props and lookups
required_patterns.category-taxonomy: Categories defined with: id (string), name (string), icon (emoji string)

architectural_constraints.project-shape: Projects: { id, title, description, thumbnail, images[], technologies[], category, githubUrl, liveUrl, featured, year }
architectural_constraints.no-api-calls: Pure static data - no external API calls, database queries, or dynamic fetching
architectural_constraints.filtering-pattern: Use Array.filter() with useMemo() for category filtering to prevent unnecessary re-computation

required_patterns.app-router-structure: Next.js 15 App Router architecture - all routes in app/ directory
required_patterns.section-based-navigation: Single-page sections with smooth scroll navigation via anchor IDs (#home, #about, #skills, #projects, #blog, #contact)
required_patterns.smooth-scroll-implementation: window.scrollTo({ top: targetY, behavior: 'smooth' }) for section navigation
required_patterns.route-groups: Optional route grouping with (pages) folder for organizational purposes (doesn't affect URL)

architectural_constraints.layout-hierarchy: Root layout.jsx wraps all pages with providers, fonts, and shell components (NavBar, SideMenu, Container)
architectural_constraints.metadata-definition: SEO metadata defined in layout.jsx export const metadata = { title, description, keywords, openGraph, icons }
architectural_constraints.page-structure: Pages export default function PageName() - named exports for metadata only
architectural_constraints.active-section-tracking: NavBar tracks active section via scroll position and highlights corresponding nav item

required_patterns.use-prefix: All custom hooks must follow 'use' naming convention (useLazyLoad, usePerformanceMode)
required_patterns.hooks-directory: Custom hooks in components/hooks/ directory with .js extension
required_patterns.return-object-pattern: Return object with descriptive keys: { ref, isLoaded, hasError } not arrays
required_patterns.client-only: Include 'use client' directive since hooks use useState, useEffect, useRef

architectural_constraints.reusability-principle: Extract cross-cutting concerns (lazy loading, performance checks) into reusable hooks
architectural_constraints.single-responsibility: Each hook addresses one specific concern - don't combine unrelated functionality
architectural_constraints.cleanup-pattern: Always return cleanup function from useEffect to prevent memory leaks (event listeners, observers)
architectural_constraints.dependency-array-accuracy: useEffect dependencies must be complete and accurate to prevent stale closures

required_patterns.tailwind-utilities: All styling via Tailwind CSS 4 utility classes - no inline styles except for dynamic values (style prop)
required_patterns.design-token-usage: Use semantic Tailwind classes: bg-primary, text-foreground, border-border (maps to CSS variables)
required_patterns.responsive-modifiers: Mobile-first approach: base classes for mobile, md:, lg:, xl: for larger screens
required_patterns.state-modifiers: Leverage Tailwind state variants: hover:, focus:, group-hover:, dark: for interactions

architectural_constraints.custom-theme-inline: Theme configuration via @theme inline directive in globals.css - no tailwind.config.js
architectural_constraints.css-variables-bridge: Tailwind classes map to CSS custom properties: --color-primary, --radius, --font-sans
architectural_constraints.animation-utilities: Use tw-animate-css library for additional animation utilities beyond Tailwind defaults
architectural_constraints.no-arbitrary-values: Avoid arbitrary values ([#ff0000]) - define custom properties in globals.css for reusable colors
architectural_constraints.gradient-pattern: Complex gradients: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1a5fb8] via-[#1e70ca] to-[#3a85d9] for consistent brand colors

required_patterns.section-component-pattern: Large page sections are separate components in components/sections/
required_patterns.helper-component-colocate: Small helper components (ProjectCard, ImageSwiper) defined in same file above main component
required_patterns.props-destructuring: Destructure props in function signature: function Hero({ title, subtitle })
required_patterns.children-prop-pattern: Layout components (Container, LoadingWrapper) accept children prop for wrapping content

architectural_constraints.file-organization: One main export per file - helper components are implementation details not exported
architectural_constraints.prop-drilling-limit: Max 2 levels of prop drilling - beyond that, use composition or context
architectural_constraints.component-size-guideline: Main section components: 200-450 lines, UI primitives: 50-100 lines, Helpers: 20-80 lines
architectural_constraints.separation-of-concerns: Sections handle layout and data, UI components handle reusable patterns, hooks handle logic

required_patterns.local-state-default: Use useState for component-local state (UI toggles, form inputs, selected items)
required_patterns.usememo-for-derived: Compute derived state with useMemo when expensive filtering/transformation is needed
required_patterns.lifting-state: Lift state to common parent when sibling components need to share state
required_patterns.context-for-cross-cutting: Use React Context only for truly global concerns (theme, loading status)

architectural_constraints.no-global-state-library: No Redux, Zustand, or similar - React hooks and Context sufficient for portfolio scope
architectural_constraints.state-colocation: Keep state as local as possible - only lift when necessary
architectural_constraints.boolean-state-pattern: Use boolean states for simple toggles: isLoading, isOpen, hasError
architectural_constraints.controlled-components: Form inputs and interactive elements should be controlled (value + onChange pattern)

required_patterns.performance-mode-hook: Import and use usePerformanceMode() in any component with heavy animations
required_patterns.usememo-for-computations: Wrap expensive computations (filtering, mapping large arrays) in useMemo with proper deps
required_patterns.lazy-load-below-fold: Images and content below fold must use lazy loading hooks

architectural_constraints.mobile-breakpoint: Performance mode triggers at < 768px screen width (Tailwind md breakpoint)
architectural_constraints.animation-reduction-targets: Disable: background particles, floating elements, complex transforms on mobile
architectural_constraints.keep-core-animations: Maintain: hover effects, entrance animations, page transitions even in performance mode
architectural_constraints.preload-critical-path: Hero section images preload with priority={true}, other sections lazy load
